title: Monotonicity of the refined logarithmic ratio
statement: Let $f$ be a monotone, nonconstant Boolean function on the sign cube, and let $r,p_a\in(0,1)$. If the biased minus-probability polynomial of $f$ at $p_a$ is at most $r$, then the refined logarithmic ratio, as a function of $p$, is nondecreasing on $(0,p_a]$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the sign cube
